_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this file is not read from here. Copy it to
this one) and replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/service-topology with the real
path to this checkout. Read hooks/README.md first - it blocks git commit,
git push, docker compose up, live broker and database clients, dependency
installs, and writes outside service-topology/, which will interfere with
ordinary development work in the same session.
Do NOT place this file at .cursor/hooks.json inside this checkout itself -
Cursor auto-loads project hooks from there, and the
placeholder script path below does not exist yet.
Both events are registered deliberately: preToolUse covers every tool
including file writes, and beforeShellExecution is the dedicated terminal
gate that also runs for cloud agents. Shell commands are therefore checked
twice, which is harmless - the guard is idempotent.
